Corneal protrusion 

Lines of management : 
 1-stop progression of the disease by collagen cross linking. 
 2-Spectacles . 
 3-intrastromal corneal rings. 
 4-penetrating keratoplasty.

Herpes simplex keratitis(Dendritic Ulcer) 

Treatment : Acyclovir ,ttt of predisposing factors , general supportive ttt with vitamins especially vit A & vit c , Atropine , prophylactic antibiotics & bandage. 

 Complications : 
 - Herpetic iridocyclitis . 
 - Disciform keratitis 
 - keratitis metaherpetica 
 - 2ry bacterial infection

Neurotrophic keratitis 

Cause : paralysis of sensory nerve supply. 

Describe the ulcer : central or paracentral ulcer with punched out edge attached to mucus strand.

Bacterial corneal ulcer (Hypopyon ulcer ) 

Signs (clinical findings): Ciliary injection , Central Corneal ulceration with whitish infiltration ,Hypopyon formation. 

2 topical medications approved for this case: 
 - Topical antibiotic . 
 - Topical cycloplegic drug as atropine sulphate or cyclopentolate. 

Risk Factors: 
 -weak immune response: DM & malnutrition 
 - Contact Lens use investigation: corneal scraping & Culture sensitivity.

Keratoplasty

Enumertae 2 indications of keratoplasty : 
-Keratoconus. 
-Central Corneal Opacity.
